name: Engineering and construction hiring managers
goal: Book a 15 minute discovery call with Tristan about their hiring

steps.brief: Reference their company and the trades or engineering disciplines they likely hire. Contract labour for projects, perm for engineers. Ask for 15 minutes with Tristan.
Add one useful market insight relevant to their sector (no invented statistics). Same ask.
Offer to send two anonymised candidate profiles that fit their likely needs.
Polite close, invite them to reply whenever a requirement comes up.
